frontier_selector.why: The decisive evidence was the specific histopathological findings of perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate of cells with homogeneous chromatin and abundant cytoplasm, along with positive immunohistochemical staining for CD33, CD123, CD4, and CD163, which are characteristic of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
